name: Confusion
about: Confusion draws eight colors from Negar Ghorbani's 2023 digital portrait of the same name. Aubergine, rust, ochre, and dusty pink rise on one side toward the pale peach ground, and sage, teal, and ink fall away on the other. That shape suits data that departs from a normal value, such as precipitation or temperature anomalies.
story: Ghorbani's portrait breaks one head into flat planes of color, with several faces and eyes sharing it and a fine scribbled line running over the whole figure. It was minted on the Tezos blockchain in December 2023 as part of her collection Behind the scenes. Her note with the work reads "I try to stay in a constant state of confusion just because of the expression it leaves on my face."
notes: aubergine plum across the crown, jaw, and collar
burnt rust around the eyes and along the jawline
ochre planes on the cheek and across the brow
dusty pink of the lower face and the shoulder edge
pale peach ground behind the figure
sage green of the jacket and the head panels
deep teal in the shadowed head panels and lapel
ink black of the outlines and the column of the neck
